nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the ego vehicle speed shall be less than or equal to the applicable speed limit.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，自车速度应小于或等于当前适用限速。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The vehicle shall comply with the applicable speed limit now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车辆应在当前或之后某个时刻达到当前限速要求。
